1. Experiment Information

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End / Report Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

3.1 Automated Workflow Description
  1. Manual Preparation
    • The run was initiated by manually filling the sample loop as prompted by the system (Utility - Pause step).
  2. ÄKTA Pure Chromatography Run
    • The ÄKTA Pure system executed the predefined protocol with online monitoring of UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond) signals at a sampling interval of 1 s.
